title: Ironwood Solar Farm weekly status
brief: I look after the Ironwood Solar Farm for its owners, and I need the weekly status page for the week ending 2026-10-30, which the asset managers will read on laptops. Headline numbers first: 184 megawatt-hours generated, a performance ratio of 81.4 percent against a target of 84, availability of 98.7 percent, and 2 inverters offline. Under "Generation trend" chart weekly generation in megawatt-hours over six weeks: W39 218, W40 203, W41 197, W42 188, W43 186, W44 184; part of the decline is the season, but the performance ratio has also slipped from 83.0 in W39. Under "Blocks" give a table of generation, availability percent and open issues for the five array blocks: Block A 41, 99.8, none; Block B 39, 99.6, none; Block C 38, 99.4, dirty panels; Block D 33, 95.8, inverters 3 and 4 faulty since 2026-10-24; Block E 33, 99.9, none. Under "Needs attention": Block D is losing about 9 megawatt-hours a week until the inverters are replaced. Under "Next": replacement inverter parts arrive 2026-11-04, a panel wash for Block C on 2026-11-06, and the annual grid inspection on 2026-11-19.

edit.request: Inverter 3 on Block D was repaired on 2026-10-31, so only inverter 4 is still faulty. Change the replacement parts arrival to 2026-11-02.
